Loss report: drone -> forgejo
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/ship job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/ship/step/ship step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
